description: Unit checks: a relative, filesystem-root or missing home is refused; swaps between a check and the create or delete it guards never redirect it; a failed delete exits 6 naming the leftover; a crashing selftest case is a FAIL line; AppData, Library and OneDrive* are pruned directly under home only. The Windows selftest comparator normalizes '\\' to '/' in expected and actual values (simulated here); drive letters are uppercased in project keys and slugs; new_plans excerpts are capped and an oversized manifest.json warns; the sweep-due count leaves out history_only stubs and scratchpad pseudo-projects. parse_entries (memory-entries.py) reads only the type sections and never a fenced heading.
